name: Zadok
bio: Zadok the scribe, along with Shelemiah the priest and the Levite Pedaiah, was appointed by Nehemiah as treasurer over the storerooms, with Hanan son of Zaccur as their assistant, because they were considered trustworthy; their duty was to distribute the supplies to their fellow Levites and priests (Nehemiah 13:13). He is a different figure from Zadok the priest who anointed Solomon.
